name: Hong Kong Milk Tea

ingredients.name: black tea bags, such as English Breakfast
evaporated milk, plus more as needed

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, bring water to a boil over high heat. Add tea bags, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer until tea is dark and aromatic, 5 to 7 minutes.

Remove from heat. Using a slotted spoon, carefully remove tea bags. Use a spoon to press down on tea bags to extract any excess tea. Whisk in evaporated milk. Season to taste with sugar and additional evaporated milk, as desired.

schema_metadata.keywords: hong kong milk tea, hong kong milk tea recipe, milk tea recipe

description: Hong Kong milk tea—a rich, creamy beverage of strong black tea and evaporated milk—requires just three ingredients and comes together in minutes.
notes: Make-ahead and storage: Hong Kong milk tea can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 5 days.
author: Genevieve Yam
